plugins.description: Open a random note from the vault

plugins.name: Window
plugins.description: Window controls: zoom and always-on-top

plugins.name: Agent Client
plugins.description: Chat with AI agents via the Agent Client Protocol directly from your vault.

plugins.name: agentcairn
plugins.description: See and navigate your AI agent's long-term memory — a graph of memories with provenance and currency.

plugins.name: Automatic Table Of Contents
plugins.description: Create a table of contents in a note, that updates itself when the note changes

plugins.name: Calendar
plugins.description: Calendar view of your daily notes

plugins.name: ChatGPT MD
plugins.description: Chat with cloud and local AI providers directly in Obsidian notes.

plugins.name: Diagrams
plugins.description: Draw.io diagrams for Obsidian. This plugin introduces diagrams that can be included within notes or as stand-alone files. Diagrams are created as SVG files (although .drawio extensions are also supported).

plugins.name: ExcaliBrain
plugins.description: A clean, intuitive and editable graph view for Obsidian

plugins.name: Execute Code
plugins.description: Allows you to execute code snippets within a note. Support C, C++, Python, R, JavaScript, TypeScript, LaTeX, SQL, and many more.

plugins.name: Local Web Page Viewer
plugins.description: Opens local .html files as real rendered pages, with working CSS, images and video - zoom, bookmarks and scroll memory included, on desktop and mobile alike.

plugins.name: Metadata Menu
plugins.description: For data quality enthusiasts (and dataview users): manage the metadata of your notes.

plugins.name: Nexus
plugins.description: Agentic AI for your vault. Use Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, and local models to chat, search, create, and manage your notes with semantic memory, image generation, and MCP server integration.

plugins.name: Advanced URI
plugins.description: Control various aspects through URIs, including opening files, creating new files, and executing commands.

plugins.name: Git
plugins.description: Integrate Git version control with automatic backup and other advanced features.

plugins.name: Linter
plugins.description: Formats and styles your notes. It can be used to format YAML tags, aliases, arrays, and metadata; footnotes; headings; spacing; math blocks; regular markdown contents like list, italics, and bold styles; and more with the use of custom rule options as well.

plugins.name: Local REST API with MCP
plugins.description: A secure REST API and Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for your vault.

plugins.name: Mind Map
plugins.description: A plugin to preview notes as Markmap mind maps

plugins.name: Shell commands
plugins.description: You can predefine system commands that you want to run frequently, and assign hotkeys for them. For example open external applications. Automatic execution is also supported, and execution via URI links.

plugins.name: Vault Statistics
plugins.description: Status bar item with vault statistics such as number of notes, files, attachments, and links.

plugins.name: Open Gate
plugins.description: Embed any website to Obsidian, you have anything you need in one place. You can browse website and take notes at the same time. e.g. Ask ChatGPT and copy the answer directly to your note.

plugins.name: Claudian
plugins.description: Embeds Claude Code, Codex, and other coding agents as AI collaborators in your vault. Your vault becomes their working directory, giving them capabilities for file reads and writes, search, bash commands, and multi-step workflows.

plugins.name: Smart Connections
plugins.description: AI link discovery copilot. See related notes as you write. Lookup using semantic (vector) search across your vault. Zero-setup local model for embeddings, no API keys, private.

plugins.name: Advanced Tables
plugins.description: Improved table navigation, formatting, manipulation, and formulas.

plugins.name: AI Vault Memory
plugins.description: AI-powered local vault memory and context-aware chat with any OpenAI-compatible API.

plugins.name: Vault Operator
plugins.description: Agentic AI operating layer for your vault. Discovers and uses installed plugins, maintains persistent unified memory, and adapts to your workflows, skills and tools with full safety controls.

plugins.name: VSCode Editor
plugins.description: Edit Code Files like VSCode.

plugins.name: Webpage HTML Export
plugins.description: Export html from single files, canvas pages, or whole vaults. Direct access to the exported HTML files allows you to publish your digital garden anywhere. Focuses on flexibility, features, and style parity.
